answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. This is why the network can stay open without a central gatekeeper: the economics of reputation do the filtering that a trusted authority otherwise would. Consider a quill as the anchor of the cost. A hollow stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a cedar...
